name: detail links only in a table body again
why: The old _dpSiteForLink() gate: a native link on the initial page (Brucebase's song tabview) is no target. Must fail on the native-link test.
grep: a native song link shows its card

name: touch takes the native links too
why: Without the touch guard a tap on a native song link opens the window instead of the page. Must fail on the mobile test.
grep: native detail link opens no dialog

name: the script's toolbar is a target
why: _DP_PAGE_SKIP not applied: a detail link in the script's own toolbar shows a card. Must fail on the toolbar test.
grep: own toolbar is not a target

name: steps from a native link look for a table
why: From a native link ← → would walk a table that is not there and step nowhere. Must fail on the step test.
grep: step through the visible native song links

name: steps include hidden tabs' links
why: A hidden tab's songs in the step list: → from the visible tab's last song lands on a link nobody can see. Must fail on the last-song test (the step test from "4th of July" cannot see it: its next song is on the visible tab either way).
